=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

The existing father [[Glasgow-1144]] is assessed at 99% (proved). James’s Newberry will expressly names son Wilson. The later family equity account places the same Wilson within James and widow Mary’s children, and the distinctive name and local family context identify Wilson-1982.

Existing strongly supported father99%; derivative will and pleading transcriptions are held. Mary’s maiden surname and Wilson’s estimated Irish birth remain separate.

Next useful test: Use the original estate packet to extend Wilson’s later family, not to reopen the direct son clause.
